title: Toybox Chess
prompt: d'ailleurs cree un new-example dun jeu d'echec façon toy-story : la 2e cat sera game
brief: A playable chess set of Toy Story toys on a bedroom floor — Woody, Jessie, Buzz, Buttercup and Trixie against green army men, on a plastic tray. Click-to-move with chess.js; the toys are pushed across the board rather than lifted. The kitchen plays black until you send someone the page's address, at which point they take that chair — two browsers, peer to peer, no server behind it. The gallery's first non-landing entry: it carries the second kind, `game`.
